caption: The drawing depicts a single fan-shaped object composed of densely layered feathers arranged in a semicircular pattern. The feathers are detailed with alternating bands of dark and light shades, primarily grays, browns, and off-whites, giving a textured appearance. Each feather displays horizontal striping or spots, with the overall fan tapering into a handle at the bottom center. The handle is illustrated with a pattern suggesting a woven or segmented structure, mainly in gray tones. The background of the image is a plain, light beige, unembellished and free from any objects or patterns, placing full focus on the central fan-like form.
title: Fan
